heading: You missed 112 marks. Here's where they went.

headline.text: You never opened 6 of the 50 questions. That is 30 of the 112 marks you missed.

groups.label: Right, then changed
groups.doLine: Change an answer only when you can point to the line that proves it wrong.

groups.label: Never opened
groups.doLine: Open every question once before you go deep on any.

groups.label: 2 minutes or more, still lost
groups.doLine: At 2 minutes, mark it for review and move on. Come back at the end.

groups.label: Wrong in under 20 seconds
groups.doLine: Read the whole question before you look at the options.

groups.label: Other wrong answers
groups.doLine: Each one has a repair below: the trap, why the key is right and one rule to keep.

groups.label: Opened, left blank
groups.doLine: Where you can rule out one of four options, choosing among the other three averages 1 mark a question under +5 for right and −1 for wrong.

groups.label: Under re-check or corrected
groups.doLine: These are being re-checked or were corrected, so they are not sorted by how they were lost.
